nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Personal and Social Well-being — Identity and Diversity
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Understanding personal identity; appreciating diversity in culture, religion and language; constitutional rights and responsibilities. Creative Arts: Visual art — exploring mixed media and design principles.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Beginning Knowledge — Life and Living
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Ecosystems and food webs; adaptations of plants and animals; interdependence of living organisms. Technology: Design and make a simple product. Physical Education: Team sports skills.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Personal and Social Well-being — Emotional Literacy
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Recognising and managing emotions; empathy and compassion; dealing with stress and anxiety; bullying prevention. Creative Arts: Music — part-singing, harmony and rhythm.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Beginning Knowledge — Matter and Materials
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Mixtures; separating mixtures; solids, liquids and gases; changes in states of matter. Physical Education: Gymnastics and movement sequences.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Creative Arts and Physical Education Assessment
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Integrated arts project — visual art and performing arts performance. Physical Education: Formal skills assessment. Personal and Social Well-being: Term consolidation.

nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Beginning Knowledge — Energy and Change
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Electrical energy, circuits and conductors; alternative energy sources; conservation of energy. Creative Arts: Visual art — printmaking techniques.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Personal and Social Well-being — Healthy Relationships
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Healthy friendships and relationships; resisting negative peer pressure; substance abuse awareness; puberty and adolescence. Physical Education: Athletics — track and field events.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Beginning Knowledge — Earth and Beyond
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): The universe; stars and constellations; weather patterns and climate; the water cycle. Creative Arts: Drama — scripting and performing.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Creative Arts — Music and Visual Art
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Music — composition and performance; Visual Art — three-dimensional art forms and sculpture. Personal and Social Well-being: Goal setting and decision-making.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Assessment and Consolidation
nodes.description: Formal Assessment: Creative Arts portfolio and performance assessment. Physical Education: Practical assessment. Beginning Knowledge: Written assessment on energy, earth and beyond. Personal and Social Well-being: consolidation.
